rules.Entry: RSI(14) crosses below 30 on a closed candle; buy at the next candle's open
rules.Exit: RSI(14) rises above 70, or the data ends
rules.Coins: Top 30 USDT spot pairs by volume, no stablecoins or leveraged tokens
rules.Position size: $100 per trade, one position per coin, long only, no leverage
rules.Benchmarks: Buy and hold the same coins; random entries with the same trade count

tests.claim: The golden cross (EMA 50 over EMA 200) means buy
Three green candles in a row means buy
Short the rebound after a dump
A 1:3 risk-reward ratio always wins long-term
Buy at the lower Bollinger Band
There is a best day of the week to buy Bitcoin
Only trade at the New York market open
